einzeiler: Kenny Hamp is arrested after a child abuse allegation escalates into a custody battle.
kurzfassung: While Cindy and Kenny are on vacation in Hawaii, Cindy's ex-husband Steve and his wife Christine report a suspicious injury on one of the children to the police. The incident, initially dismissed as a rough wedgie, quickly escalates into criminal child abuse allegations and a Department of Human Services investigation. Following pressure from Steve, his mother, and various witnesses, a judge ultimately grants emergency custody of the children to Steve.
stichpunkte: Kenny Hamp is arrested on September 30, 2019, and charged with child abuse following a vacation in Hawaii.
Steve and his second wife, Christine, report to the Steamboat Springs Police Department that one of Cindy's nine-year-old twin boys has a severe injury.
Police and DHS launch separate investigations, reviewing medical exams, text messages, and a post-trial journal kept by Steve and Christine.
Medical professionals and family members offer conflicting accounts, noting physical symptoms could stem from constipation or a wedgie.
Steve's mother, Alida, meets with police to share claims that her grandson is afraid of Kenny and made graphic disclosures.
Steve files an emergency motion for custody supported by letters from a teacher and a therapist.
Judge Mary Hope rules in favor of Steve, granting him and Christine emergency custody of the children pending the DHS investigation.

kapitel.titel: Alida's Testimony at the Police Department

clips.hook: Did you do it? The surprising question after a misdemeanor arrest
clips.text: The hosts discuss their weekly format that combines literary analysis and pop culture commentary with authors and online creators.

clips.hook: Photographs taken in Vegas become the only physical proof
clips.text: Discrepancies emerge regarding a Hawaiian vacation while the group shifts focus to ongoing discomfort from a wedgie.

clips.hook: Why a child welfare assessment typically takes sixty days
clips.text: A survivor recounts waking up to an intruder at the foot of her bed, highlighting extreme cases of stalking and control.

clips.hook: What a misdemeanor charge means in Colorado
clips.text: Kamala reviews a post-trial journal and questions Steve and Christine about paperwork they are examining together.

clips.hook: High praise for a stepmother in the middle of a family crisis
clips.text: Legal definitions are clarified regarding a class one misdemeanor in Colorado, which carries a maximum jail term of 364 days and a fine.

beschreibung:
Cindy has a simple explanation for her son’s injury, but the boy’s father, stepmother and grandmother told investigators a completely different story. All three met with the Steamboat Springs Police Department and shared a much darker version.
